ValidationRule.description: Lead Status cannot be changed to Converted manually. A lead has to be converted by the conversion process.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'ANZX_Leads', ISCHANGED( Status ), NOT(ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( Status ) , 'Converted')), ISPICKVAL( Status ,'Converted'), IsConverted = FALSE )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Lead Status cannot be changed to Converted manually. A lead has to be converted by the conversion process.
